artificial_masking.comparison: recover full business-hour subtotal on final in-stock days; paired errors; not evidence of organic stockout recovery
artificial_masking.eligibility: all business-hour stock status zero on a day
artificial_masking.estimators: zero-fill observed subtotal, uniform exposure scaling, learned pooled hourly-share scaling
artificial_masking.fit: hourly sales-share profile from fit-period in-stock rows of fitting identities only
artificial_masking.hours: 6..21 inclusive; masking last 4 and last 8 hours separately

benchmark_predeclared.environment: single-machine Windows local loopback; one worker; no cloud/production claims
benchmark_predeclared.report: achieved/not-achieved and actual throughput, latency distribution, RSS; omit portable performance guarantee

capacity_simulation.action_grid: 0.1 normalized sales increments, per-item maximum ceil(1.5 * max(predicted q90,0.1) / 0.1), bounded 100 increments
capacity_simulation.demand: next-day observed normalized sales is evaluation proxy only
capacity_simulation.interpretation: synthetic one-period normalized-capacity exercise, no inventory, real lead time, money or retailer-savings claim
capacity_simulation.items: first 8 fitting identities by locked hash with records and forecasts on each final date, selection by identity and availability only
capacity_simulation.objective: minimize equally weighted expected shortage*3 + excess*1 across three scenario demands (q10,q50,q90); sensitivity shortage weights 1 and 5
capacity_simulation.solver: exact dynamic programming on stated finite integer grid and capacity constraint; compare proportional point allocation, no allocation, oracle hindsight; brute-force small-instance certificate

cohort.claim_scope: bounded hash sample of history-eligible series; no full-population representativeness claim
cohort.eligibility: at least 180 training rows through 2024-12-31, including at least 60 rows in 2024-10-01..2024-12-31
cohort.selection: first 1024 eligible store-product identities sorted by SHA256(stockout-v1|store_id|product_id); no evaluation availability filtering
cohort.transfer_holdout: selected identities with integer SHA256 digest modulo 5 == 0 excluded from every model fit and calibration; identity transfer is not cold-start because historical lags remain available

estimand: one-day-ahead observed normalized sales, updated with yesterday outcomes; not fixed-origin seven-day forecasting or latent demand identification

feature_policy.excluded: future sales, realized weather, discounts, activity, stock status, and all contemporaneous fields; no actual stockout indicator in future predictors
feature_policy.features: lagged observed sales ratios and levels, 7/28-day history summaries, historical stockout fraction, target day-of-week and annual calendar harmonics only; strict event_date < target_date and arrival <= as_of

minimum_acceptance: A valid negative result is acceptable. Completion requires computed baseline/model results, explicit attrition, provenance, measured local service and meaningful failure-class tests. No requirement to outperform.
model_selection: report all fixed models; select validation minimum MAE among seasonal_4week and pooled_poisson for served point forecast; no final-based tuning; quantile interval remains separately labelled pooled quantile

pooled_model.target: observed sales divided by max(previous-28-day mean,0.1)

quantiles.calibration: single scalar conformalized quantile correction on in-cohort calibration rows, finite-sample ceil((n+1)*0.8) quantile of max(lower-y,y-upper); lower clipped zero; temporal dependence voids distribution-free coverage guarantee

status: locked before model fitting or evaluation-outcome inspection; source training examples only encountered in official dataset card
systems_acceptance: source hashes and full contracts audited
durable SQLite typed source and job ledger
replay/crash equivalence, transactional publication and worker lease fencing
as-of late-arrival tests and no-future tamper
bounded request bodies, input errors, deduplication/conflict quarantine
concurrent idempotent submission and distinct worker claims
uncertainty: 500 paired bootstrap replications of final-date daily mean absolute-error differences (pooled minus seasonal), resampling contiguous 7-day date blocks; report exploratory percentile 95% interval, dependence across series preserved within days
